last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Sat 08-01 — TWO HALVES, AND BOTH MATTER. FIRST HALF, THE ANTIFREEZE KIT BROKE OPEN: he came in asking to run yesterday's dead volley (fired at the wrong hour, never answered) and went 3-cold-of-4 on the freeze-breakers, all survival tier, all from cold English situations. கொஞ்சம் மெதுவா [பேசுங்க] — THE 07-27 GAP CLOSED: six days ago cold he gave 'medhuva pesa', bare stem, and today unprompted the -ங்க was THERE. தமிழ்ல எப்படி சொல்றது? — closes english-word-order; last time he built 'enna naan tamizh sollen' off an English skeleton, today the real shape unaided, and the -றது nominalizer beat landed (nobody in particular does the saying, which is why naan had no seat). கொஞ்சம் நில்லுங்க — first contact, cold, softener attached. Only என்ன சொன்னீங்க? was hinted, and only because I had shown it a line above — RETEST COLD, it does not count. THE -ங்க TAIL IS A MACHINE NOW, NOT A LOOKUP; that was the antifreeze kit's whole diagnosed gap and from-scratch is now where it fires. Survival 23/34. NEW SLIP (2nd, 1st was 07-27): puriyala-for-reopen — he owns the giving-up line and reaches for it where the move is to REOPEN. Not graded as a miss per the 07-27 ruling; the clause that landed was 'puriyala closes the door, enna sonneenga opens it'. SECOND HALF, THE HARD DATA: he asked me to decode the Chitra akka eavesdrop tape (so the youknow-la channel IS being listened to — it was the collect ask that was never being answered, not the tape). Full decode, and the reveal landed — the aunties on that tape are gossiping about HIM. Then I stole சொன்னோம் off the tape and demanded the day-recap in a fresh room. He gave 'market-ku poganum, romba nalla iruka'. BOTH COMMISSIONED SLIPS TESTED AND BOTH MISSED — 1pl-past-om now 4x, past-tense now 3x. And the miss is WORSE-SHAPED than 07-30: 'poganum' is the OBLIGATION form, not a mangled past. Under production load he grabs any non-past form and never marks the scene as past AT ALL — the -ஓம் tail is the second-order problem; reaching past tense is the first. THE FORMAT IS THE FINDING: this was taught by ear twice (the போனோம் episode 07-31, the day-recap memo 08-01 13:22 which he ACKED at 19:25 — eight hours before missing it). Per audio_channels.md the same mistake twice through one format is that format's answer: ears are not reaching his mouth on this one. CHANNEL CHANGED TO DRILL, rendered and published 08-01 (drill_2026-08-01_1726.mp3, 11 items, four of them -ஓம், zero -ஏன் forms — twin law held). He confirmed mouth-free time today before the render. Silence is the demand; this is the first drill commissioned off a failed test rather than a due list. NEXT SESSION OPENS ON THIS: did the drill reach the mouth? If ponnom/irundhuchu still miss after a drill, the problem is not the channel and the diagnosis restarts. FIELD MISSION REJECTED AS CONTRIVED — 2nd time (1st 07-15), banked verbatim. 'unga kai ruchi super' assumed a mother-in-law's cooking; he does not live with one and they ate OUT. He was RIGHT to refuse — கை ருசி is hand-taste and a restaurant meal has no hand to compliment, so the refusal proves the word landed. Missions now ride a slot guaranteed in HIS life inside 24h. Rebuilt: he initiates (so the slot cannot fail) — say one thing to his wife in Tamil, and when she fires back at speed, do NOT switch to English, fire konjam medhuva sollunga into live speed. LORE IS THE ACCELERANT, SEVENTH SESSION RUNNING: every cold fire today came wrapped in a breakdown he asked for himself (puriyala, nillunga, the whole eavesdrop tape). Density low, lore high — do not raise the dose. ENGINEERING NOTE FOR @build (do NOT fix in-session): render_drill.py generates its answer key fresh per run with no case-marking validation — an earlier dry-run produced 'மார்க்கெட்டுல போனோம்' (locative where the verb needs dative -குக்கு), and the shipped sheet has 'இடது பக்கம்ல' where the correct form is பக்கத்துல. A wrong answer key in a drill is repeated OUT LOUD ten times; this lane needs a validation gate. CARRIED: (1) soak order குடுங்க / episode lane stands — venum-for-kudunga finally commissioned after 19 days. (2) Delight barely open: mil-table 3/10, social 1/11, zinger and gossip 0.
